SELECT
S.SURVEY_NO AS "surveyNo", S.SURVEY_NM AS "surveyNm", S.SURVEY_CN AS "surveyCn", S.SURVEY_TY_CD AS "surveyTypeCd", S.SURVEY_STTS_CD AS "surveySttsCd", S.SURVEY_BGNG_DT AS "surveyBgngDt", S.SURVEY_END_DT AS "surveyEndDt",
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SURVEY_RSPNS SR WHERE SR.SURVEY_NO = S.SURVEY_NO ) AS "totalAnswerCount",
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_NO) FROM SURVEY_RSPNS SR WHERE SR.SURVEY_NO = S.SURVEY_NO ) AS "participantCount",
0 AS "answerRate"
FROM SURVEY S
WHERE S.SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}

SELECT
SURVEY_NO surveyNo, SURVEY_NM surveyNm, SURVEY_CN surveyCn, SURVEY_TY_CD surveyTypeCd, SURVEY_QITEM_CN surveyQitemCn, SURVEY_BGNG_DT surveyBgngDt, SURVEY_END_DT surveyEndDt, SURVEY_STTS_CD surveySttsCd, RGTR_ID rgtrId, APT_CD aptCd
FROM SURVEY

ORDER BY SURVEY_BGNG_DT DESC

SELECT
DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR( RSPNS_CN, 4000, 1 ) AS answer,
COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM SURVEY_RSPNS
WHERE SURVEY_NO = #{surveyNo}
GROUP BY DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR( RSPNS_CN, 4000, 1 )
ORDER BY cnt DESC
